name: Romanzado / Erromantzatua (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Romanzado (a triangle within a laurel wreath on red).
history: Municipal flag of Romanzado/Erromantzatua; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
